title: Finder's Fee
pitch: Lowell Pike sold a portrait through Victor's contacts. He swears it went cheap and the fee should shrink. Collect it all.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: An empty crate propped on the fountain wall, an auction house stencil and a lot number on the lid. A public sale, not a quiet one.

clue_b.label: The estate car
lines: Empty frames in the back, a sale slip on the dash. The portrait went for four times what Pike told Victor.
